info.name: Sockless Mail (web address)
info.summary: Serves the Sockless Mail External App at /apps/socklessmail/
info.description: A companion to the Sockless Mail External App (app id sockless_mail, deployed through AppAPI). It shows the same mail page at /apps/socklessmail/ instead of AppAPI's /apps/app_api/embedded/sockless_mail/sockless_mail and points the Sockless Mail entry of the app menu there. Everything else, including the mail page itself, still comes from the External App.
info.author: Jimmy Everling
